chapati.source_name: Food Composition Table for Pakistan (FAO-hosted PDF)
chapati.source_reference: https://www.fao.org/fileadmin/templates/food_composition/documents/regional/Book_Food_Composition_Table_for_Pakistan_.pdf#page=15 ; printed page 8, Composition of Food, A) Cereal and cereal products, row 19: Wheat Bread / Chapati, Food Energy 259 K.cal per 100 g edible portion. Visually verified 2026-10-18.
notes: Published nutrition value: 259 kcal per 100 g edible chapati.
The separate Traditional Foods chapati record on printed page 48 (PDF page 54) lists 282 kcal per 100 g. It is not averaged or combined with the selected cereal-table record.
The cooked edible weight in grams is supplied by the user. No standard piece weight, predefined serving size or image-derived weight is assumed.
This result is an estimate based on the supplied weight and published nutrition value. Actual calories may differ due to recipe and measurement variation.
Use for plain wheat chapati only. Added oil, ghee, butter, fillings, accompaniments and other preparations are not covered. No automatic adjustments are made.
